name: QNITY ELECTRONICS, INC.
moat_justification: Moderate moat 6/10: qualified, mission-critical semiconductor materials with long qualification cycles, portfolio breadth and co-development ties give real switching costs, but the business is cyclical, concentrated, levered from the spin, and has no standalone track record to prove pricing power through a downturn.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
THIN_HISTORY: only 3 fiscal years of data
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 4.1x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Good semiconductor-materials franchise, moat 6/10 — does not clear 15% at $121.87 (weighted IRR 9.05%, IV@15 $58.18); even the super-bull case is 14.29%; hurdle-clearing price is $58.18 on weighted numbers.
moat_for: Mission-critical qualified materials — long fab qualification cycles create switching costs
Portfolio breadth across semiconductor fabrication and interconnect / advanced packaging
Deep co-development relationships and local-for-local footprint near major fabs
AI / advanced-node content growth — advanced-node sales grew >20% in Q2 2026
moat_against: Semiconductor cyclicality — consumables demand tracks fab utilization
Customer and China concentration — China >30% of sales per research
Levered spin balance sheet — $4.0B debt, ~$250M expected 2026 interest
Elevated growth capex — TTM capex $344M and rising for Delaware/Taiwan builds
No long standalone history — only 3 carve-out fiscal years, spin completed Nov 1 2025
